# 5 Best Robotics ETFs to Buy in 2026
## What Is the Best Humanoid Robotics ETF?
KOID claims to be the first ETF focused specifically on humanoid robotics.

However, Themes Humanoid Robotics ETF ( [BOTT](https://money.usnews.com/funds/etfs/technology/themes-humanoid-robotics-etf/bott)), up 54% over the past year, has been around a little longer, since 2024.

The three main robotics ETFs are Global X Robotics & AI (BOTZ), ROBO Global Robotics & Automation (ROBO), and iShares Automation & Robotics (IRBO).
